title: A small country with a big planning question
annotation: Andorra begins this story as a compact mountain country shaped by population growth, tourism, limited land, and the question of how to grow without losing what makes it livable.

title: Not all land is buildable land
annotation: The story narrows from Andorra’s full 468 km² to the much smaller share of land that can realistically absorb future growth.

title: The same growth can take very different shapes
annotation: Overgrowth spreads pressure outward. Density concentrates change. The choice is not only how much Andorra grows, but where that growth lands.

title: Four possible futures, year by year
annotation: A year slider and scenario toggle will let the user move through projected futures and see how population, economy, access, and emissions change together.

title: Growth becomes real through infrastructure
annotation: The future is not only population. It is electricity demand, road pressure, hospital beds, school capacity, and whether people can still access what they need.

title: The future is a decision, not just a forecast
annotation: Compare the scenarios side by side and ask what kind of growth Andorra should choose: continuity, density, overgrowth, or degrowth.
